items.title: Pay annual gas bill balance
items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 30 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is Fri 27 Nov 2026. This is a private company's invoice, so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the 30-day period runs from the invoice date itself. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (27 Nov) is not counted, so counting starts 28 Nov 2026. 30 calendar days later (§188 Abs. 1 BGB) falls on Sun 27 Dec 2026. Since that day is a Sunday, §193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day, Mon 28 Dec 2026.

warnings: The invoice offers partial payments 'nach Absprache' (by arrangement) but does not say how to arrange this - contact the sender directly using the phone number or email printed on the letterhead (not any contact details from elsewhere) if partial payment is needed.

Before paying, verify the IBAN DE93 3705 0198 0002 0500 00 belongs to Beispielwerke Versorgung GmbH (e.g. via a previous bill or their official website), since payee-name checks on transfers are not a substitute for your own verification.
